mutation.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.18] Retain immutable-candidate external review
mutation.body:
Part of #833

## Summary

- retain the failed immutable-candidate external-review report as non-proving evidence bound to candidate `9c7e57d412d61898bd44ab00d53e31afbb779e5c`
- retain the executable-review addendum and remediation disposition record without turning either artifact into release approval
- add narrow #818 supersession proof showing only the exact 17-row proposal approval via PR #832; release approval remains out of scope
- keep Sprint 10 ledger issue 522 open for the complete TAIL-06 finding-disposition ledger and final release-blocker denominator

## Validation

- `ruby -c .csdlc/prepared/issues/833/validate-external-review-handoff.rb`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/833/validate-external-review-handoff.rb --all` — pass; handoff/report candidate binding plus seven negative cases
- `ISSUE818_SUPERSESSION=.csdlc/prepared/issues/833/issue-818-candidate-current-supersession.json ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/833/validate-issue-818-candidate-current-supersession.rb` — pass; exact #818 17-row supersession scope
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/833/test-issue-818-candidate-current-supersession.rb` — pass; eight malformed, forged, or scope-widened receipts rejected
- `python3 -m json.tool .csdlc/issues/833/cards/sor.values.json`
- `python3 -m json.tool .csdlc/issues/833/cards/srp.values.json`
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`

## Boundaries

- This PR does not auto-close issue 833 after merge.
- Sprint 10 ledger issue 522 remains open after this PR.
- This PR is not release approval and does not claim the failed external review became a pass.
- Issue 522 remains the final ledger gate for every retained and newly returned finding.
